lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: The Closed Road. For a hundred years nobody|came in. For a hundred years she never went out.
lines.text: The Closed Road. For a hundred years nobody came in. For a hundred years she never went out.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: I grew these walls to keep the war out.|They did. They kept everything out.
lines.text: I grew these walls to keep the war out. They did. They kept everything out.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: They'll fight you, child. They only|know the one word you taught them.
lines.text: They'll fight you, child. They only know the one word you taught them.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Then I'll teach them a second word.|It's a short one. Open.
lines.text: Then I'll teach them a second word. It's a short one. Open.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: One down. It felt like pulling|out my own hair. Two more.
lines.text: One down. It felt like pulling out my own hair. Two more.

lines.speaker: messenger
lines.subtitle: My lady! Pipwell's burning.|They asked for you by name.
lines.text: My lady! Pipwell... Pipwell's burning. They... they asked for you. By name.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Nobody burns while I watch. Not any more.|Go home, Pipwell. Grow it back.
lines.text: Nobody burns while I watch. Not any more. Go home, Pipwell. Grow it back.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Too slow. I was always too slow|for the ones at the border.
lines.text: Too slow. I was always too slow for the ones at the border.

lines.speaker: messenger
lines.subtitle: Fernby! The old stones are|walking into the houses!
lines.text: Fernby! The... the old stones are walking. Into the houses!

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Two. I'm taking a side, Maelis. It's theirs.
lines.text: Two. I'm taking a side, Maelis. It's theirs.

lines.speaker: maelis
lines.subtitle: You called me out of the wood.|I've waited forty years to hear that.
lines.text: You called me out of the wood. I've waited forty years to hear that.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: The last root. My first wall. Goodbye.
lines.text: The last root. My first wall. Goodbye.

lines.speaker: messenger
lines.subtitle: Hollins Cross, please! They're at the mill.
lines.text: Hollins Cross... please. Please, they're... they're at the mill.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Three messengers, three answers.|I could get used to answering.
lines.text: Three messengers, three answers. I could get used to answering.

lines.speaker: obren
lines.subtitle: Stay in your garden, gardener.|You were always so good at it.
lines.text: Stay in your garden, gardener. You were always so good at it.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: I've left the garden. Show me again,|Master. I'm showing you.
lines.text: I've left the garden. Show me again, Master. I'm showing you.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.subtitle: For the first time in a hundred years,|the green went out of its own border.
lines.text: For the first time in a hundred years, the green went out of its own border.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: The Signet's warm. It's pointing at the|others. Let's not keep them waiting.
lines.text: The Signet's warm. It's pointing at the others. Let's not keep them waiting.

lines.speaker: messenger
lines.subtitle: My lady, you're really coming out here? With us?
lines.text: My lady... you're really coming? Out here? With us?

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: Burn it, then. It grows back.|That's the one thing I've always known.
lines.text: Burn it, then. It grows back. That's the one thing I've always known.

lines.speaker: ysolde
lines.subtitle: I left... too late...
lines.text: I left... too late...
